columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: Table primary key. Ideally values are automatically incremented using a database sequence

columns.name: COVERAGE_IN_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: Flag column to indicate if the coverage data is in sync with the schedule and demand

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the relevant schedule coverage calculation

columns.name: AGGREGATED_BASELINE_DEMAND
columns.description: Aggregate baseline demand value, measured in minutes (BASELINE)

columns.name: AGGREGATED_ACTUAL_DEMAND
columns.description: Aggregate actual demand value, measured in minutes (actual)

columns.name: AGGREGATED_ASSIGNED_SHIFTS
columns.description:
Aggregate duration , in minutes, for the assigned shifts
ALUE

columns.name: AGGREGATED_OPEN_SHIFTS
columns.description: Aggregate duration, in minutes, for the open shifts value

columns.name: RECALCULATION_ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ESS process request ID used in the most recent coverage recalculation

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Standard enterprise identifier column for multi tenancy support

columns.name: COVERAGE_CALC_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when the coverage was last calculated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
